page.layout: One page of verse, one column of text; running head at top centre; page number top right; marginal notes in the right margin (two notes: "Templum Dianæ Tauricæ,& sacra." and "Oreστes, Pyladesi"); signature mark at foot centre.

p.i: Hac ego sum terra, patriæ nec pœnitet, ortus,
Consortem Phœbi gens colit illa deam.
Templa manent hodie vastis innixa columnis,
Pérque quaterdenos itur in illa gradus.
Fama refert illic signum cæleste fuisse,Templum Dianæ Tauricæ,& sacra.
Quóque minus dubites, stat basis orba Dea.
Ara que, quæ fuerat natura candida saxi,
Decolor affuso tincta cruore rubet.
Fœmina sacra facit tedâ non nota iugali,
Quæ superat Scythicas nobilitate nurus.
Sacrifici genus est (sic instituêre parentes)
Aduena virgineo cæsus ut ense cadat.
Regna Thoas habuit Mæotide clarus in ora,
Nec fuit Euxinis notior alter aquis.
Sceptra tenente illo, liquidas fecisse per auras,
Nescio quam dicunt Iphigeneian iter:
Quam leuibus ventis sub nube per aera vectam
Creditur his Phœbe depositsse locis.
Præfuerat templo multos ea rite per annos,
Inuita peragens tristia sacra manu:
Cum duo velifera iuuenes venere carina,
Presserúntque suo littora nostra pede.
Par fuit his ætas, & amor: quorum alter Orestes,Orestes. Pylades.
Alter erat Pylades, nomina fama tenet.
Protinus immitem Triuiæ ducuntur ad aram,
Euincti geminas ad sua terga manus.
Sparsit aqua captos lustrali Graia sacerdos,
Ambiat vt fuluas infula longa comas.
Dúmque parat sacrum, dum velat tempora vittis,
Dum tardæ caussas inuenit ipsa moræ:
Non ego crudelis, iuuenes ignoscite, dixit,
Sacra suo facio barbariora loco.
Ritus is est gentis, qua vos tamen vrbe venitis,

page.notes: Marginal notes read from the right margin; the note "Oreστes" is transcribed as printed (Greek-looking letters in the printed word "Orestes"). Catchword absent. Some words in the first lines are faint at the page edge. Line ending "venitis" and "Templum" note are from the right margin; the faint show-through of the reverse page is not transcribed.
